Dutch Court Bans Chinese BYD Model Over Land Rover Defender Likeness

A Dutch court has banned a model from Chinese carmaker BYD from being sold in the European Union due to its resemblance to Land Rover's Defender. BYD plans to appeal the ruling, which does not prevent the car from going on sale in Britain in January. Jaguar Land Rover has welcomed the ban.
